title: The Texas tenors, Chu Berry, Billie Holiday and Teddy Wilson at the Hot Cha
summary: They sort the arrival of Texas tenors and recall Chu with Billie Holiday and Teddy Wilson at the Hot Cha and Wellworth Tavern.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: (Unintelligible). Well, just going back to this sort of order of tenor players again. Now, all those Texas people -- I mean like the Budd Johnsons and --
Buddy Tate --
-- Buddy Tate, now they come up there because -- and Herschel Evans.
Herschel Evans.
Now, they must be coming up about 1930 or so.
They came after us, yes. Ben came there before --
No, Ben came after, because --
That's right.
-- he was playing piano when Budd Johnson first heard him.
That's right, played piano in the theater there.
Yeah. So, yeah, then like Illinois Arnett could one later and (unintelligible) still. But Chu was coming -- Chu must have come in almost next, I guess.
Let me see. When Chu, Billie Holiday and Teddy Wilson playing at a place called still there, called
the Hot Cha, but he had an upstairs to it, the -- that's where they were playing. (Unintelligible) was on tenor then. That's before he ever made a big name.

That's right. Ben, the next place they were playing, down to a place called the Wellworth Tavern on 126th Street and Seventh Avenue -- just torn down now -- big place, big room back there, cabaret; that's with Ben, Teddy Wilson, Billie Holiday singing. I forgot who the drummer was back there, but four pieces. He was playing tenor then after he left --
Well, there was a place, though, up there where I heard Billie -- '37, Harlem -- I don't know what they called that. She was singing with a club up there, some old club. That was 37 --
37 -- 37th Street?

Well, one was the Hot Cha, but the bar is still there now. It's still there, but the (unintelligible) part, they tore that out. They played upstairs there. Billy did the singing. Chu, Teddy Wilson -- she was the vocalist. I forgot who was on the drum, three pieces.
So Chu was on tenor then?
Chu was on tenor then. Yeah.
